PermissionSet.description: SMF-10 probe: lets a user call the user-context Files read-back endpoint. Grants no record, object or File access; Case and File visibility still come from the SMF-3 baseline sharing. Assign to MF-TECH, MF-SUPPORT and MF-RESTRICTED alike so denials are decided by sharing, not by Apex class access.
PermissionSet.label: SMF-10 Files Probe Access
